entries.title: A task's browser fills its view when you maximize it
entries.body: When you maximize a task's browser, the page inside now lays itself out for the larger view, instead of showing a stretched picture of the page at its usual size. It follows the window as you resize it, and restoring the view puts the page back at its usual size.

picture.alt: A task's browser maximized across the window, its page of releases laid out in seven columns edge to edge
